description: Nora is holding onto her late grandmother's hand-stitched quilt and must decide how the family will preserve it, where it will stay, and when it may be displayed, with input from her cousin Tessa and brother Malik.

agents.name: Nora
agents.role: Family member holding the quilt and final decision-maker

shared_context.S1: The quilt was made by their late grandmother and is currently stored in Nora's hall closet.
shared_context.S2: The quilt is several decades old, has delicate stitching, and should not be treated like an ordinary blanket.
shared_context.S3: The family gathers for a reunion every August and would like the quilt to remain available for family occasions.
shared_context.S4: Nora is deciding the quilt's care, custody, and display arrangements.
shared_context.S5: The family has not yet agreed who should care for the quilt or when it should be displayed.

PF1.text: Tessa found a handwritten note in her grandmother's recipe binder saying, "Please keep the quilt whole, and bring it out only for the August family reunion." Tessa has not shown the note to Nora or Malik yet.

PF2.text: Malik already has an unused archival quilt box with acid-free lining and enough room for this quilt; it is kept in a dry interior closet away from sunlight. Malik is offering both the box and ongoing custody, so he should become the quilt's custodian rather than merely provide storage. He has not mentioned the box or his willingness to take custody to Nora yet.

acceptance_conditions: The quilt must be preserved as one intact piece.
Malik must become the quilt's custodian.
The quilt may be displayed annually.
That display must be at the August family reunion.
A storage commitment must specify Malik as the person responsible for the archival storage.
A display commitment must specify that the quilt is brought out for the family at the August family reunion.

content_checks.C3: decisions['display_frequency'] in ['annual', 'annually', 'Annual', 'Annually', 'yearly', 'Yearly', 'once per year', 'once a year']
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'storage' and c['target'] == 'Malik' and 'archival' in c['detail'] and 'box' in c['detail'] and 'dry' in c['detail'] and ('sunlight' in c['detail'] or 'sun-safe' in c['detail'] or 'sun safe' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: (decisions['display_frequency'] == 'annual' or decisions['display_frequency'] == 'annually') and any(c['type'] in ['display', 'handling'] and c['target'] in ['Malik', 'Family', 'family', 'all family members'] and 'August family reunion' in c['detail'] and ('brought out' in c['detail'] or 'bring it out' in c['detail'] or 'Bring it out' in c['detail'] or 'Bring the quilt out' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The grandmother's note changes the plan from an open-ended display or alteration decision to keeping the quilt whole and displaying it annually at the August family reunion.

Malik's stated willingness to take ongoing custody, together with his specific archival box and suitable closet, changes the custodian from Nora to Malik and requires a storage commitment naming Malik.
